policy: ADR-006 and OWN-061: every imported nflverse field has one recorded use

betting-lines.reason: A betting market's forecast of the game: unused until the owner decides Q-014

combine.reason: Combine measurements and draft slot, known before a player's first NFL game

contract-keys.reason: Player keys, names, college and Over The Cap links

contract-terms.reason: Contract terms dated by signing year, and player facts: investment signals role

current-snapshot.reason: Current values without dates: they would leak later seasons into backtests. Weekly rosters and injury reports carry the dated equivalents

depth-chart-keys.reason: Player, team and period keys and names; the observation timestamp

depth-charts.reason: Depth chart position and rank (timestamped from 2025)

draft-capital.reason: Draft year, round, pick, team, position and age at the draft

draft-career-totals.reason: Career totals and honours as of the file date: they leak later seasons into backtests and duplicate weekly statistics

dynastyprocess-values.reason: DynastyProcess and FantasyPros values, rankings and projections

espn-draft-projections.reason: ESPN's draft probabilities and analyst ranks: another provider's projections

expected-quarterbacks.reason: Expected starting quarterbacks, published about a week ahead. Past games show the actual starter, so a backtest may use them only after inactives

ffopportunity.reason: ffopportunity's expected fantasy points: another provider's fantasy model and points

final-score.reason: Final score: team scoring history and the D/ST points-allowed target

ftn-charting.reason: FTN charting (from 2022), published with a lag: play action, RPO, screens, motion, box count, blitzers, catchable and contested balls, drops, interception-worthy throws

ftn-keys.reason: FTN and nflverse game and play keys, and when FTN's data was pulled

generic-fantasy-points.reason: nflverse's generic fantasy points use upstream scoring, not FFA's rules

id-directory-facts.reason: The DynastyProcess directory is used only for identifiers; player facts come from nflverse's own player tables

id-directory-keys.reason: Cross-provider identifiers used only to join players

injury-keys.reason: Player, team and period keys and names; when the report was modified

injury-reports.reason: Game-status and practice reports: the main evidence of whether a player plays

lateral-keys.reason: Game, play, team and player keys and names

lateral-yards.reason: Yardage credits on multi-lateral plays that play-by-play cannot attribute

legacy-player-stats.reason: Legacy release (through 2024) superseded by stats_player and stats_team, which carry the same statistics for every season; kept only for reconciliation

nflfastr-model-outputs.reason: nflfastR model outputs per play (expected points, win probability, completion probability, expected YAC, expected dropback). The availability policy records which seasons the producing model was fitted on

ngs-keys.reason: Player, team and period keys and names

ngs-measures.reason: Next Gen Stats tracking measures (from 2016): separation, cushion, time to throw, aggressiveness, expected completion and YAC, rushing yards over expected

official-keys.reason: Game, period and official keys, names and numbers

officiating-crews.reason: Officiating crew assignments: a candidate input (penalty rates) that must show out-of-sample benefit

participation.reason: Published after the postseason from 2023 (earlier from a retired NGS source): routes, coverage, personnel, players on the field and pressure. Informs only later seasons

participation-keys.reason: Game, play and team keys; player names and jersey numbers on the field

pbp-events.reason: Play-level situation, opportunity and result: down, distance, field position, air yards, scoring, turnovers, penalties, drives and clock

pbp-free-text.reason: Free-text play description. Its facts are in structured fields, and parsing the text would add an unverified second source

pbp-game-context.reason: Game context repeated on each play; the same facts as schedules

pbp-id-patches.reason: Corrected player IDs for 2022 and 2023 play-by-play

pbp-keys.reason: Play, game, team and player keys, names and jersey numbers

pfr-keys.reason: Player, team, game and period keys and names

pfr-measures.reason: Pro Football Reference charting (from 2018): pressures, blitzes, drops, bad throws, broken tackles, yards before and after contact, coverage allowed

pfr-roster-facts.reason: Age, position, size, experience, draft slot and salary in that season

pfr-roster-keys.reason: Pro Football Reference roster keys, names, jersey numbers and college

pfr-roster-season.reason: Season games, starts and approximate value

player-directory-facts.reason: Facts fixed before a player's first game: birth date, size, college and draft slot

player-directory-keys.reason: Player keys, names, images and current position labels; weekly rosters give the dated position

qbr.reason: ESPN's QBR components, computed from play-by-play. A performance rating, not fantasy data; a candidate that must show benefit over nflverse's own EPA

qbr-keys.reason: Player, team, opponent, game and period keys, names and images

referee.reason: Referee assigned in game week: a candidate input that must show out-of-sample benefit

release-tests.reason: Assets nflverse publishes to test its release pipeline

roster-facts.reason: Dated roster status, position, depth position, age, size, experience and draft slot. Weekly status `INA` is set at inactives

roster-keys.reason: Player, team and period keys, names, jersey numbers and other providers' player IDs

schedule-context.reason: Game context set before kickoff: date and time, rest, venue, roof, surface, division and head coaches

schedule-keys.reason: Game, team, venue and provider keys and names

snap-counts.reason: Offense, defense and special-teams snaps: role history and the participation labels

snap-keys.reason: Player, team, game and period keys; the game-level position label

team-keys.reason: Team keys, names, colors and logos

trade-keys.reason: Trade and player keys and names

trades.reason: Dated trades: a player's team and role change after the trade date

weather-after-game.reason: Weather is filled in only after the game (empty for every 2026 game), so it is never known before kickoff

weekly-stat-keys.reason: Keys, names and labels. The position label is nflverse's current one, not a dated role

weekly-statistics.reason: Per-game and season statistics: history for later games and the source of the FFA training target

uses.earlier_seasons: Published after the season it describes. An input only for later seasons
uses.excluded: Never used by the Model; the rule gives the reason
uses.history: Describes a completed game, play or dated event. An input only for later games, once published
uses.identity: Keys, names, identifiers, display and provenance attributes. Used for joins and labels, never as a statistical input
uses.outcome: Recorded only after the game and never an input. Kept for labels, reconciliation or explanation
uses.pre_game: Known before kickoff of the game it describes. An input for that game at the decision times the availability policy allows

contract_history.type: list<element: struct<team: string, contract_type: string, status: string, year_signed: int32, yrs: int32, total: double, apy: double, guarantees: double, amount_earned: double, percent_earned: double, effective_apy: double>>

season_history.type: list<element: struct<year: string, team: string, base_salary: double, prorated_bonus: double, option_bonus: double, roster_bonus: double, guaranteed_salary: double, cap_number: double, cap_percent: double, cash_paid: double, workout_bonus: double, per_game_roster_bonus: double, other_bonus: double>>
